desc:
Chewits Blue Raspberry Stick Pack is bursting with fresh, tangy and sweet blue raspberry flavour — perfect for anyone who loves fruity sweets with a twist. These soft and chewy treats melt in your mouth, delivering an intense taste experience everyone can enjoy

Chewits · Sticks · Fruity
ingredients:
RASPBERRY FLAVOURED CHEWY SWEETS

Ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, fruit juice from concentrate (orange, raspberry, pineapple), vegetable fats (palm, coconut), acid (lactic acid), concentrate from (spirulina), natural flavouring, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein.
